text: With a base station, and then the base station is connected with what is called the mobile operator network, that is then connected with the internet. Now, in this case, when we look at the network's architecture, we also refer to this initial part of the network where we have the users, the points of access, as edge, and then we call this wild network that connects the points of access as network core. Okay, so especially in the case of cellular networks, we have the edge and the core network. So we often hear these two terms in order to differentiate between the first part of the network where we have the wireless links, and the other part of the network, the inner part of the network where we have keyboard connectivity that is called core. Okay, so in terms of architecture, we have, therefore, those two examples: Wi-Fi cellular that, as we said, include wireless users connected with a point of access through wireless links.
